facts.fact: The French embassy's support to the AMECC 2 civil-registration modernisation project is put at EUR 1 million, per the interior minister (Al-Watwan, 2026-10-15).
The AMECC 2 coordinator says the new national civil-registration agency is to implement the strategic plan for modernising civil registration (Al-Watwan, 2026-10-15).

note: No digital entry at registration offices is stated; the pre-digitisation study is finished and four pilot centres are being upgraded.
